name: acuaponia
description: Orquestador de servicios del sistema acuapónico (frontend + backend + cámara)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n backend,frontend,camera -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:camera"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
